caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a rectangular top and four elongated, curved legs. Each leg ends in a carved detail resembling an animal's paw. The entire table is rendered in a rich, reddish-brown wood color with visible wood grain texture. The edges of the tabletop are beveled, and there is additional carved detail at the top of each leg where it meets the sides of the table. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or decorations, providing emphasis on the table and its details.
title: Table
